name: Newcastle-under-Lyme Open 2017

venue.name: [St John Fisher Catholic College] (http://www.sjfcc.net/)
venue.address: Ashfields New Road, Newcastle-under-Lyme, Staffordshire, ST5 2SJ

information: You must pay the entry fee online via the button on the [UKCA site](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/newcastle-under-lyme-open-2017/registration) before your registration is approved. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 120. Registration opens at 19:00 on Saturday 28th January and will close at midnight on Sunday 2nd April.
